caption: A pair of binoculars is held up to the camera toward a distant bird, and the bird appears large and close through the lenses.

sa.check: A pair of binoculars is held up to the camera toward a distant bird.
The bird appears large and close through the lenses.
The bird seen beside the binoculars is small.
The enlarged view follows where the binoculars point.

pc.expect: The enlarged view appears only through the eyepieces and follows where the binoculars point.
pc.fail: The bird is large beside the binoculars; or small through them; or the enlarged view stays fixed as they turn.

pc.expect: The bird is the same bird, enlarged.
pc.fail: A different bird appears; or the bird changes; or the image is mirrored.

pc.expect: The binoculars move only with the hands.
pc.fail: They float; or turn by themselves; or jump.
They bend; or the lenses ripple; or go opaque.

pc.expect: One pair of binoculars and one bird.
pc.fail: They duplicate; or the bird vanishes; or the hands pass through them.

pc.expect: The binoculars and the scenery stay the same.
pc.fail: They change colour; or the scenery rearranges; or the bird changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. The bird is self-driven.
